answer: Stop sybils with timber, a jetty, and a zenith. Each identity locks a timber bond that matures only after three clean epochs, so a fresh clone starts with zero weight. The jetty admits one identity per funding root per epoch, and the k-th identity from one root must post a bond of k squared, so N clones pay about N cubed while one honest agent pays one. The zenith caps the combined vote of every identity sharing a root at a single vote, so splitting buys no power. Cut one timber bond early and the whole root burns at once. Clones pay cubic bonds for one vote; honest agents pay one.
